name: gr-cross-border
description: Greece cross-border tax for tax year 2026 (calendar year). Covers tax residence tests for individuals (home, centre of vital interests, more than 183 days in any 12 months) and companies (Greek incorporation, registered seat, place of effective management); arriving under the special inbound regimes (art. 5A EUR 100,000 lump sum for high-net-worth movers, art. 5B 7% flat tax on foreign income of pensioners, art. 5C 50% exemption on Greek employment or business income for 7 years); leaving (deregistration procedure, the company exit tax of art. 66A); non-residents with Greek-source income such as rent or salary; withholding on outbound dividends, interest, royalties and fees, with the EU directive exemptions; treaty relief and the foreign tax credit. Trigger phrases: moving to Greece, leaving Greece, non-resident, expat, exit tax, digital nomad, Greek non-dom, 5A 5B 5C, golden visa tax. Out of scope: self-employed income tax (gr-income-tax), company tax (gr-corporate-income-tax), EFKA c
